en: One fascicle of the Commentary on the Yoga Vajraśekhara Sūtra: Chapter on the Alphabet.

By [Master Daoyi], Grand Master with Rank Equal to the State Councilor, Special Advancement, Acting Minister of the Court of State Ceremonial, Duke of Sui with a Fief of Three Thousand Households, conferred purple robes, posthumously titled Minister of Works, and canonized with the title Dajian (Great Mirror).

Translated by the Tripiṭaka Śramaṇa Amoghavajra of the Great Xingshan Temple, who possesses Great and Vast Wisdom, by Imperial Decree. The letter-gateway Ā: because all phenomena are fundamentally unarisen.
The gateway of the syllable Ā: because all phenomena are quiescent.
The gateway of the syllable Ī: because the root of all phenomena cannot be apprehended.
The gateway of the syllable Ī: because calamities and misfortunes of all phenomena cannot be apprehended.
The syllable-gateway Uḥ: because metaphors for all phenomena are unattainable.
The syllable-gateway Oṃ: because the diminution of all phenomena is unattainable.
The syllable-gateway *ṛ*: because the supernormal powers (*abhijñā*) of all phenomena cannot be apprehended.
The syllable-gateway *ṝ*: because the categories and analogies of all phenomena cannot be apprehended.
The letter-gateway *ra*: because defilement is unattainable in all phenomena.
The letter-gateway *la*: because sinking is unattainable in all phenomena.
The letter-gateway *ya*: because seeking is unattainable in all phenomena.
The letter-portal Ā: because the sovereignty over all phenomena is unattainable.
The letter-portal O: because the torrent of all phenomena is unattainable.
The letter-gateway *Aum* (Auṃ): because the transformational birth of all phenomena cannot be apprehended.
The letter-gateway *Am*: because the limit of all phenomena cannot be apprehended.
The gateway of the letter *a* (惡): because all phenomena are remote and unapprehendable.
The gateway of the letter *ka* (迦): because all phenomena are free from karmic action.
The gateway of the letter *kha* (佉): because all phenomena are equal to space and unapprehendable.
The letter-gate GA (upper tone): because the practice of all phenomena is unattainable.
The letter-gate GHA (departing tone, aspirated): because the unity of all phenomena is unattainable.
The letter-gateway of the upturned nose-sound *ya* (𑀬): because the constituent parts of all phenomena are unattainable.
The letter-gateway of *za* (𑀚): because all phenomena are free from all transition and change.
The syllable-gateway CA (磋): because the images of all phenomena are unattainable.
The syllable-gateway JA (惹): because the arising of all phenomena is unattainable.
The syllable-gateway *Zàn* (去): because the adversaries of all phenomena cannot be apprehended.
The syllable-gateway *Rǎng* (穰): because the wisdom of all phenomena cannot be apprehended.
The gate of the letter *Ṭha* (upper tone): because pride (*māna*) is unapprehendable in all phenomena.
The gate of the letter *Ṭha* (upper tone): because nourishment (*puṣṭi*) is unapprehendable in all phenomena.
The syllable-gateway NA (upper tone): because in all dharmas, enemies cannot be apprehended.
The syllable-gateway TA (departing tone): because in all dharmas, grasping and maintaining cannot be apprehended.
The syllable-gateway NA (pronounced with the nasal sound of the nose), because in all dharmas dispute is unapprehendable.
The syllable-gateway TA (with the high tone), because in all dharmas suchness is unapprehendable.
The gateway of the letter THA (Ṭha): because the abiding place of all phenomena cannot be apprehended.
The gateway of the letter NA (Na): because the giving of all phenomena cannot be apprehended.
The syllable-gateway *ḍha*: because the entire realm of phenomena (*dharmadhātu*) is unapprehendable.
The syllable-gateway *na*: because the names of all phenomena are unapprehendable.
The syllable-gateway *pa*: because the ultimate truth (*paramārthasatya*) of all phenomena is unapprehendable.
The gateway of the syllable PHA: all phenomena are not solid, for they are like a mass of foam.
The gateway of the syllable MA: the bondage of all phenomena cannot be apprehended.
The gateway of the syllable *ba* (pronounced with a departing tone): because the existence of all phenomena cannot be apprehended.
The gateway of the syllable *maṅ*: because the self (*ātman*) of all phenomena cannot be apprehended.
The syllable YA is a gateway, because the vehicle of all phenomena cannot be apprehended.
The syllable RA is a gateway, because all phenomena are free from the defilement of dust.
The syllable LA is a gateway, because the characteristics of all phenomena cannot be apprehended.
The syllable-gateway VA: because all phenomena are cut off from the path of speech.
The syllable-gateway ŚA: because the intrinsic nature of all phenomena is quiescent.
The syllable-gateway ŚA: because the nature of all phenomena is dull.
The syllable-gateway *Sa* (upper tone): because all phenomena and all truths are unattainable.
The syllable-gateway *Ha*: because the cause of all phenomena is unattainable.
The syllable-gateway *kṣa*: because all phenomena are ultimately unattainable.
One fascicle of the *Yogatantra-Śrī-Vajraśekhara-Sūtra: Commentary on the Chapter on the Alphabet*.
